result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback: it limits the termination payment to fees for three preceding months, applies it only to a convenience termination, excludes HDI breach or failure, and makes it the sole amount payable by reason of termination. The changes are targeted, and the existing installment mechanics are preserved. Drafting quality is reduced by the malformed sentence beginning “Payment is determined” and because an express “not to exceed” formulation would state the three-month cap more clearly.
